Class Ball

DynamicCircleEntity
org.example.entities.objects.Ball
public class Ball extends DynamicCircleEntity
The ball entity that bounces around the game field.

Handles wall bouncing, paddle deflection, brick destruction, and speed increases.

  • Constructor Details

    • Ball

      public Ball(Coordinate2D initialPosition, GameLevel gameLevel)
      Creates the ball at the given position and links it to the game level.
      Parameters:
      initialPosition - the starting position of the ball
      gameLevel - the game level used to report scoring and life loss

  • Method Details

    • increaseSpeed

      public void increaseSpeed()
      Increases the ball speed by a fixed step, up to the maximum allowed speed.

    • notifyBoundaryTouching

      public void notifyBoundaryTouching(SceneBorder border)
      Reacts to the ball touching a scene border. Left/right/top borders invert the relevant velocity component; the bottom border causes the player to lose a life and resets the ball.
      Parameters:
      border - the border that was touched

    • onCollision

      public void onCollision(List<Collider> collidingObjects)
      Handles collisions with the paddle and bricks. Uses Yaeger vector helpers to reflect the ball off colliders.
      Parameters:
      collidingObjects - the list of objects the ball collided with this frame
